observations: Close-up of the control panel of a digital keyboard.
Brand 'YAMAHA' is visible on the lower right of the panel in photo 0.
The LCD screen is powered on and displays a menu with song titles like '001 BreatheModern' and '001 Live! Grand Piano'.
The screen shows 'MAIN 1' and 'PERFORMANCE REPOSITORY' at the bottom.
The unit has a silver-colored chassis with various control buttons and a large central knob.
A watermark 'SEUNSTICS ENTERPRISE' is visible across the center of the image.

risks.risk: The keyboard may not power on or the LCD screen may be dead or have dead pixels.
risks.proof: A video showing the keyboard booting up and the screen displaying a different song or menu.

risks.risk: The internal speakers may be blown or have distorted sound.
risks.proof: A video with clear audio of the keyboard playing a demo song.

risks.risk: The keys may be unresponsive, sticky, or have dead spots.
risks.proof: A video of a person playing a scale across the entire keyboard.

risks.risk: The model number is not visible, which determines the specific value and features.
risks.proof: A photo of the model name printed on the back of the unit.
risks.if_unproven: as the lowest-value Yamaha digital keyboard of this generation

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the back of the keyboard showing the model name and serial number.
Video of the keyboard powered on and playing a song to test the speakers and keys.
Photo of the LCD screen while the keyboard is off to check for dead pixels.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
